# Project Horae

> A thinner, band-shaped, open-source e-paper watch built in public: a miniaturized successor to SQFMI's Watchy.

- [Build log](https://projecthorae.com/): the timeline of every milestone, newest first, with renders and photos.
- [Source](https://github.com/backmeupplz/project-horae): CAD (build123d), the KiCad board, research notes, the order and assembly guides.
- [Research](https://github.com/backmeupplz/project-horae/tree/main/research): displays, batteries, electronics and CAD tool write-ups.
